description.narrative: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is essential for the success of the Ghana-Netherlands Seed Partnership, as it enables adaptive management, fosters shared learning among partners, and ensures the project remains responsive to stakeholder needs and realities on-the-ground. Learning is not treated as a separate activity, but is fully integrated in the implementation process

policy-marker.narrative: The ultimate goal of the Ghana-Netherlands Seed Partnership is to improve the performance, sustainability and resilience of vegetable farming systems in Ghana through skills and market development, variety testing and improving the enabling environment in the vegetable seed sector. To achieve this, the project takes a holistic approach to address the productivity, regulatory, knowledge and investment challenges involving all relevant stakeholders, including growers, the Ministry of Food and Agriculture, agricultural colleges, agricultural research institutes, seed companies, seedling companies and distributors.

description.narrative: The Ghana Netherlands Seed Partnership (GNSP) is a public-private partnership designed to improve the performance, sustainability and resilience of Ghana's horticultural farming system through skills and market development, variety testing, and a stronger enabling environment for the vegetable seed sector. To achieve this, the project takes a holistic approach to address the productivity, regulatory, knowledge and investment challenges by involving all relevant stakeholders, including growers, the Ministry of Food and Agriculture, agricultural colleges, agricultural research institutes, seed companies, seedling companies and distributors.
